description: This is a code-behind ASP.NET Web Forms page for the admin panel of an online examination system. It contains event handlers for button clicks that navigate to various pages within the application.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the AdminPanel ASP.NET page, handling page lifecycle and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Admin Queue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Set Exam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Edit Exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Login page for logging out.
